2: #include "date.h"

4: using namespace std;
5: 
6: namespace {
7: const int DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH[] = {0,   31,  59,  90,  120, 151,
8:                                  181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334};
9: const int DAYS_IN_MONTH[] = {31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31};
10: }  // namespace
11: 
12: Date::Date(int year, int month, int day) : year(year), month(month), day(day) {}

15: 
16: int Date::getMonth() const { return month; }
17: 
18: int Date::getDay() const { return day; }
19: 
20: int Date::getMaxDay() const {
21:     if (month == 2 && isLeapYear()) {
22:         return 29;
23:     }
24:     return DAYS_IN_MONTH[month - 1];
25: }
26: 
27: void Date::show() const { cout << *this; }
28: 
29: bool Date::isLeapYear() const {
30:     return (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || (year % 400 == 0);
31: }
32: 
33: int Date::totalDays() const {
34:     int y = year - 1;
35:     int days = y * 365 + y / 4 - y / 100 + y / 400;
36:     days += DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH[month - 1] + day;
37:     if (month > 2 && isLeapYear()) {
38:         days += 1;
39:     }
40:     return days;
41: }

43: int Date::operator-(const Date& other) const {
44:     return totalDays() - other.totalDays();
45: }
